input.command: gh repo view --json nameWithOwner,hasIssuesEnabled -q '.nameWithOwner+" issues="+(.hasIssuesEnabled|tostring)'; gh issue list --state all --limit 8 --json number,title,labels -q '.[]|"#\(.number) \(.title) [\(.labels|map(.name)|join(","))]"'; gh label list --limit 30 -q '.[].name' 2>/dev/null | tr '\n' ' '
input.description: Inspect GitHub repo issues and labels
